subject: Quick fix/ perf improvement for Field Mask Create (#839)
reason: The change replaces the heap-allocated virtual FieldMask class hierarchy with a plain 16-byte value struct. Every production call site was checked: SetField keeps the same bounds CHECK and bit semantics; CountSetFields returns the same counts for all field counts 1-64 (the old single-field constant-1 path is matched because SetField is always called right after construction); GetMask returns the same integer the old AsUint64 did in the only context where it is read (FlatPositionMap::Create encodes masks only when num_text_fields > 1, where both implementations return the raw mask).
